review.why: Takes a blog post from research and brief through draft to an SEO pass and scripted quality gates.
review.summary: Three modes: research the competing pieces and write a brief, draft with an outline and section rules, then optimize with four bundled scripts for SEO, readability, brand voice and publish gates. It covers meta tags, internal links and a pre-publish checklist, and warns early about thin content, cannibalization and intent mismatch.
strengths: Pushes back on vague topics instead of guessing the angle
Rule: no "studies show" without the actual source
Failing gates block publishing until fixed
cautions: Gate thresholds (readability 70, keyword 3 to 5 times) are mechanical heuristics
References and the brief template are not read here
